summary: Implemented S027 (Sector ETF Cross-Sectional Momentum, Confluence P12/S025+S026+S027 page 24838145): strategies/xsect_equity_momentum.py reuses strategies/xsect_base.py's rank_weights()/portfolio_returns() (same engine as live S009 / S012) on the 11 SPDR sector ETFs (XLE/XLF/XLK/XLV/XLI/XLY/XLP/XLU/XLB/XLRE/XLC) instead of crypto perps -- funding_day is a zero frame since ETFs pay no funding, xsect_base.py itself left untouched (backs the live S009 book). Default formation window 126/21 trading days (Jegadeesh-Titman-style 6-1 month, deliberately different from S012's 30/0 crypto default) -- a literature-motivated first guess, not tuned. Deliberately did NOT reuse xsect_base.metrics() (hardcodes 365 cal. days/yr for always-on crypto; would mis-annualize a ~252-day/yr equity book) -- used utils.report.make_report(periods_per_year=252) instead, same convention as fx_carry/overnight_drift. Fetched real data via utils.data.load_yf() (11 new data/raw/<TICKER>/<TICKER>_1d.csv caches, 2000-01-03..2026-09-21 for 9 sectors, XLRE from 2015-10-08, XLC from 2018-06-19 -- real SPDR launch dates). 7 Gate 0 tests added in tests/strategies/test_xsect_equity_momentum.py (no-look-ahead, zero-funding reduces to plain price return, dollar-neutral weights, min_universe floor flattens thin days); full tests/strategies/ suite (55 tests) green, no regression to S009/S012/xsect_combo. Gate 0 PASS on real data. Honest E2 gross result with the untuned default config, full 2000-01-03..2026-09-21 history: Sharpe 0.04, CAGR -0.00%, WinRate 51.0%, 13 of 27 years with a positive mean daily net return -- essentially NO edge, and E3 makes it worse (Sharpe -0.05 at 2bps/side, -0.19 at 5bps/side). No parameter search was run to try to find a positive result (would be exactly the overfitting this project's own conventions warn against, e.g. S001/S002/S016). Likely structural reason, stated as a hypothesis not a proven cause: 11 SPDR sectors are all slices of the same S&P 500 and highly intercorrelated, so cross-sectional return dispersion is much smaller than S012's ~24 more idiosyncratic crypto perps -- a fundamentally weaker setting for a rank-the-extremes momentum book. No promotion; registry status stays idea (now idea-with-a-null-first-backtest, like S001/S002/S016), not backtested with a live edge.

Corrected the S027 implementation after re-reading the actual Confluence spec (page 24838145, S027 heading says 'месячный ребаланс' + long-only top-N): the first draft (see preceding change-log entry, same session) had mechanically copied S012's daily dollar-neutral long/short book onto the new universe without checking it matched what S027 itself specifies. Rewrote run_backtest() to be the canonical spec'd version: monthly rebalance (decide on the last trading day of each month from that day's fully-realized signal via monthly_momentum_signal(), apply starting the NEXT trading day via one shift(1), hold flat until the following month -- own no-look-ahead convention, distinct from S012's same-day-shift convention since here the signal is not applied same-day), long-only equal-weight top-N (own weight builder, _long_only_top_n_weights_at() -- xsect_base.rank_weights() cannot produce a long-only book, it always divides by bottom_n). Kept the original daily dollar-neutral version, renamed run_backtest_dollar_neutral_daily_variant(), explicitly labeled as an exploratory variant, not 'the' S027 -- both still reuse xsect_base.portfolio_returns() (periodicity-agnostic, safe for both); xsect_base.py itself untouched throughout (backs the live S009 book). 11 Gate 0 tests now (was 7): added test_monthly_rebalance_dates_are_month_ends_only (weights must only change the day after a detected month-end) plus no-look-ahead/long-only/min-universe/cost coverage for the canonical path, kept the daily-variant's original tests renamed to match. Full tests/strategies/ suite (59 tests) green. Added an equal-weight-all-11-sectors (no ranking) benchmark to the runner -- this is the honest finding: the momentum-ranked top-3 book (CAGR 6.95%/Sharpe 0.46/MaxDD -47.08%, gross, full 2000-01-03..2026-09-21 history) is statistically indistinguishable from the naive equal-weight benchmark (CAGR 6.86%/Sharpe 0.46/MaxDD -53.92%) -- the momentum SELECTION adds no measurable value over plain diversified US sector beta with these untuned parameters; cost sensitivity is small either way since monthly rebalance means low turnover (Sharpe only drops 0.46->0.42 at 10bps/side). This agrees with the daily dollar-neutral variant's own honest null result (Sharpe 0.04) -- both readings say the same thing: 11 highly intercorrelated S&P 500 sub-indices give too little cross-sectional dispersion for rank-based selection to show an edge here. No parameter search was run to look for a positive result. No promotion; still idea stage with a null-to-negative first backtest under two different, both spec-consistent-ish, constructions.

Documented the corrected S027 backtest (monthly long-only vs daily dollar-neutral variant vs equal-weight benchmark, see preceding entries) in Confluence per confluence-docs, via the REST-API fallback (.env creds, device_bash) same as the S025 documentation step. Updated 'P12 / S025+S026+S027' page id 24838145 (v3->v4): inserted a dated subsection under the S027 heading with the implementation-history note (first draft mismatched the spec, corrected), the E2/E3 numbers, and the equal-weight-benchmark note macro. Appended a row to 'Апдейты (журнал работ)' page id 10584066 (v5->v6, newest row on top) with the same summary.
